mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.wcs_task_h ( wcs_task_id, task_type, task_status, eqp_pallet_id, cycle_no, pallet_id, order_task_id, station_id, shuttle_id, sku_code, lot_id, qty, task_message_id, ack_message_id, ack_result, dispatched_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{wcsTaskId}, #{taskType}, 'DISPATCHED', #{eqpPalletId}, #{cycleNo}, #{palletId}, #{orderTaskId}, #{stationId}, #{shuttleId}, #{skuCode}, #{lotId}, #{qty}, #{taskMessageId}, #{ackMessageId}, #{ackResult}, #{dispatchedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM') ) ON CONFLICT (wcs_task_id, task_type) DO UPDATE SET task_status = 'DISPATCHED', pallet_id = EXCLUDED.pallet_id, order_task_id = EXCLUDED.order_task_id, station_id = EXCLUDED.station_id, shuttle_id = EXCLUDED.shuttle_id, sku_code = EXCLUDED.sku_code, lot_id = EXCLUDED.lot_id, qty = EXCLUDED.qty, task_message_id = EXCLUDED.task_message_id, ack_message_id = EXCLUDED.ack_message_id, ack_result = EXCLUDED.ack_result, fail_reason = NULL, dispatched_at = EXCLUDED.dispatched_at, started_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'STARTED', started_at = #{startedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, completed_at = #{failedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}
